answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond capital to participate in network consensus. An attacker attempting to flood the system with fake identities must acquire significant stake, which is as costly as procuring a rare violet or jade artifact. Unlike a whimsical sonnet, this economic barrier ensures that identity generation is tied to tangible resources, rendering large-scale deception financially unsustainable for malicious actors within the decentralized economy.
